in_sanskrit.name: लक्षण
in_sanskrit.meaning: लक्षणम् कृत्त्वा लक्षयितुम् - to mark, indicate, signify
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who marks, indicates, presence of something, or signifies it. The one who measures, counts, calculates, determines, or discerns. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Lakshana Murthi, as He is the one who marks or identifies the beginning and end of creation.

in_hindi.name: लखन
in_hindi.meaning: लक्षण देना - to give a sign, mark, or indication
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who gives a sign, mark, or indication. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Lakhan, as He is the one who marks or identifies the beginning and end of creation.

in_tamil.name: லகன்
in_tamil.meaning: அவர்களிடம் சிறப்பு விவரத்தையும் செய்யும் ஒவ்விடம் அவர்களையும் அறிவிக்கையும் அதுக்கலையும் உருவாக்குவார் - one who reveals, uncovers, explains, points out, and indicates
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who reveals, uncovers, explains, points out, and indicates. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'लक्षण', which means 'to mark, indicate, signify'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Lakshana Murthi, as He is the one who marks or identifies the beginning and end of creation.

in_telugu.name: లక్హన్
in_telugu.meaning: మర్చేశేయేల్లో చేయ్యేదోయేదో శోధనేదో - one who makes known, shows, and reveals
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who makes known, shows, and reveals. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'लक्षण', which means 'to mark, indicate, signify'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Lakshana Murthi, as He is the one who marks or identifies the beginning and end of creation.

in_marathi.name: लखन
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Giver of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: लखन हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, लखन refers to Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. His name symbolizes the bestower of prosperity, good fortune, and abundance. He is also known as 'Laxmi-Narayan' – the god of wealth with his consort Lakshmi.

in_bengali.name: लखन

in_bengali.long_meaning: लखन একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, लखन refers to Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. His name symbolizes the bestower of prosperity, good fortune, and abundance. He is also known as 'Laxmi-Narayan' – the god of wealth with his consort Lakshmi.
